BiblicalUsage: Ratash is to dash down, to dash in pieces — the cruelest word of war. Isaiah says of Babylon, 'Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes'; Hosea says of Samaria, 'their infants shall be dashed in pieces'; and Nahum says of Thebes, 'her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets.'
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that this word is in the Bible so that I do not look away: war's cruelty falls on children, and the prophets name it plainly — and God judges the nations that do it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
